metadata.scenario: A customer requires urgent service to fix an unexpected malfunction. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Helen Johnson. I’m calling because I’m having an issue with my physical therapy equipment. I’m sorry to hear that, Helen. Can you tell me more about the issue? Yes, the resistance on my therapy machine has suddenly malfunctioned, and I can't use it at all. That sounds frustrating, especially since you’ve been working so hard on your recovery. Exactly! I really need it fixed as soon as possible, especially with my upcoming session. I understand. Let me check our schedule for a technician to come out today. Please, it’s urgent. I feel like my progress will be impacted if I can’t use it. I’ll do my best to make this happen. Can you confirm your address for the technician? Sure, it’s 123 Elm St., Wichita, KS. Thank you! I’ll send someone out right away. How long will that take? I’m looking at about two hours for a technician to arrive. Does that work for you? Yes, that should be fine. Great! I’ll schedule that right now. Oh, and can I ask about my next physical therapy appointment? Of course, you’re due for a session later this week. Should I confirm that with Dr. Rodriguez? Yes, please. I’d like to keep that on the calendar. I’ll make sure it’s scheduled and confirm with you after. Thanks! I really appreciate your help with this. You’re welcome, Helen. We’re here to support you. And one more thing, could I also get a quote for additional sessions? Certainly! Our physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 and $140. Okay, I might want to add a few more sessions if I can fit it in my schedule. That sounds like a plan! I'll follow up with the technician's arrival and confirm your appointment with Dr. Rodriguez. Thank you so much, Margaret. You're a lifesaver! It’s my pleasure, Helen. Take care, and we’ll be in touch soon. Bye! Goodbye!
